high_level_description: This image captures a serene sky scene during what appears to be either dawn or dusk. The sky is a gradient of colors, transitioning from a deep blue at the top to lighter shades of blue and pink near the horizon. There are wispy clouds scattered across the lower part of the sky, with some areas tinged with pink and orange hues, suggesting the presence of sunlight just below the frame. In the upper middle portion of the image, there is a small crescent moon visible against the blue sky. The moon is not very bright, indicating it might be a thin crescent phase.
